name: Checklist — Show Rundown (builds in)
description: Half-frame checklist that BUILDS IN: the card slides in from the right, then each numbered item reveals one at a time (opacity + slide-from-right, staggered) — a rundown being laid out live. Nothing is checked or struck (no completion beat) — the payload here is the build-up itself. Sibling of checklist-project-setup, which instead opens as a stable list with completed items struck. Timing is edit-authored via Resolve marker sync (ADR-0042): fps is the Syntax timeline's true 29.97 NDF rate, the duration is the head marker's 300-frame span (exactly 10.01 s), and each item's enter start pins to its beat marker's exact frame — the uneven-looking fractions are frame-exact by construction (frame/300), not hand-tuned. Channel chrome inherited unchanged from ADR-0040 (mono numbers, flat card chrome; the strike-on-chrome exception is declared there and unused here — nothing strikes).
